description: Search a library of real Meta ads and the landing pages they drive to. `search` first matches ads whose headline, copy or advertiser name contain every word, best match first, then fills the page with semantic matches, so a brand or product name works and so does a description of the ad's angle, offer or visual style. Combine it with companyIds, displayFormats, pageTypes and technologies to narrow, and with hookTypes, angleTypes, offerTags and funnelStages to filter on what the ad's creative was read as (each ad carries these in `tags`, null until it is read). Users say 'brands' for advertisers and 'landing pages' for site pages — map their words onto these filters. performanceScore and scoreTiers come from a transparent longevity + duplication heuristic; they are NOT spend, reach or ROAS and must never be presented as such. Returns metadata plus the creative's media URLs; call sightglass_get_ad for one ad's full detail, sightglass_get_site_page for the page an ad drives to. Each row carries one picture; call the matching get_ tool for full screenshots, page HTML, technology logos and every creative. Fields the current plan does not include come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic). When a list is capped, `planLimit` is set: `maxResults` is the cap, `hiddenResults` is how many matching rows were not returned, and there is no next page. Do not estimate omitted values. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

companyIds.description: CSV of company ids. Users usually call companies 'brands'.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of this same call, to get the next page. Keep every other argument the same.

limit.description: Results per page: 20 by default, up to 40. Use the user's number when they give one; for more than 40, page with cursor.

pageTypes.description: CSV of landing-page types: offer_page,advertorial,listicle,quiz,lead_capture,homepage,pdp,collection,blog,marketplace,app_store,social_profile. The stored names product, squeeze and other still work.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

scoreTiers.description: CSV of testing,scaling,growing,optimized,winning. These tiers come from a transparent longevity + duplication heuristic — they are NOT spend, reach or ROAS, and must never be described as such.

search.description: Ads whose headline, copy or advertiser name contain every word come first, best match first; semantic matches over the copy, creative caption and advertiser fill the rest. A brand or product name works, and so does a description of the angle, offer or visual style (for example 'before and after skin results with a discount code').

technologies.description: CSV of stack names on the brand's site, e.g. Shopify,Klaviyo

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_ads
title: Find ads
